errorCatalog.cause: No matching immutable approval is bound to the attempt
errorCatalog.fix: Obtain a reviewed approval before retrying

errorCatalog.cause: The requested ID is not the current verified attempt in the required state

errorCatalog.cause: The reader cannot safely interpret the retained version

errorCatalog.cause: Persisted authority is readable but not eligible to advance
errorCatalog.fix: Run the exact read-only next command and resolve the reported prerequisite

errorCatalog.cause: Another publisher or retained crash lock owns the operation
errorCatalog.fix: Reconcile the publication lock before retrying

errorCatalog.cause: An unexpected internal error prevented a trustworthy result
errorCatalog.fix: Run the offline doctor and inspect the stable diagnostic code
